items.description: Fix the `src/app/api/flashcards/route.ts(98,18)` type error: `const created = []` is inferred as `never[]` (evolving-array inference applies to `let`, not `const`), so `created.push(card)` fails with TS2345 (`any` not assignable to `never`). Annotate the array. The repo-wide convention for collected created records in API routes is `any[]` (6 usages: auto-grow, fts x3, scrape x2; zero routes use Prisma model types; this file itself uses `const where: any`), so `const created: any[] = []` is the intended fix. No runtime/logic change. Also covers `src/app/page.tsx(257,15)` TS2322: `boolean | null` not assignable to `boolean | undefined` on the Button `disabled` prop (missed in the 2026-09-20 re-plan because the baseline tsc ran with the stale worker's fix already in the worktree); the seeded fix appends `?? undefined` (null and undefined are equivalent for React disabled). Behavior-preserving.

Annotate as `any[]` per repo convention (cf. src/app/api/scrape/route.ts:128); fix page.tsx:257 with `?? undefined`. Preserve behavior.
